SELECT fish_date_season AS season, CAST(fish_date_doy/10 AS INT)*10 AS doy_bucket, SUM(yt) AS yt, SUM(anglers) AS anglers, ROUND(SUM(yt)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0),4) AS yt_per_angler, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM trips WHERE cls='three_quarter'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
SELECT avail_season, avail_doy, value FROM climate WHERE index_id='oni' ORDER BY avail_season, avail_doy

SELECT cls, fish_date_season AS season, SUM(yt) yt, SUM(anglers) anglers, ROUND(SUM(yt)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0),4) AS yt_per_angler, COUNT(*) n
FROM trips WHERE cls IN ('hd_am','hd_pm','hd_unspecified','full_day')
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
SELECT cls, COUNT(*) n, MIN(fish_date_season) min_s, MAX(fish_date_season) max_s FROM schedule WHERE cls='full_day' GROUP BY 1
